metadata.title: Mobile Posture & Compliance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for evaluating mobile device posture and compliance signals to support risk‑based access decisions.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile posture assessment, compliance evaluation services, device telemetry, and risk signaling interfaces.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern defining continuous evaluation of device posture without granting execution trust.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Mobile Posture & Compliance aligns with NIST guidance for continuous monitoring, mobile security posture, and Zero Trust decision logic.

metadata.remarks: Mobile Posture & Compliance defines the security signals required to assess the current health and risk state of mobile devices. This pattern deliberately produces signals only and does not define enforcement or remediation actions.

components.title: Mobile Platform Posture Assessment
components.description: Assesses the security health of the mobile operating system and platform configuration.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Impairment of mobile OS defenses to bypass security protections.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Posture assessment detects deviations from secure platform baselines.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mobile security posture is continuously monitored.
Integrity of mobile platform components is assessed.

components.title: Mobile Compliance Evaluation
components.description: Evaluates whether a mobile device meets institution‑defined compliance requirements.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of non‑compliant devices to access protected resources.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Compliance checks validate adherence to required security controls.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least functionality expectations inform compliance status.

components.title: Mobile Risk Signal Generation
components.description: Generates risk signals based on posture, compliance, and threat indicators for Zero Trust access decisions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of security signals to evade risk detection.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Telemetry and signal reporting enable informed access decisions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Risk signals inform access control decisions.
Account usage decisions consider device risk context.

components.title: Posture Signal Consumption Boundary
components.description: Ensures posture and compliance signals inform decisions without granting execution or administrative trust.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted context to gain excessive access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strict interpretation boundaries prevent signal over‑trust.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mobile access decisions are constrained by risk context.
Least privilege enforced regardless of posture results.
